label: Zoom in / out
intent: The magnifier zooms in. Light: the lying bar swings up to stand across the other, minus becomes plus, lands upright with a hit and a small rebound, and a beat later the lens swells, magnifying the plus, and settles. Strong: the bar winds back first, swings past upright and settles in the same fold add-remove uses, and the lens dips, then swells harder and settles in two beats. The handle never moves. The reverse lays the bar back down while the lens shrinks: zooming out.

bar-v.//: drawn lying (v1's zoom-out state); it turns -90 degrees to stand up

lens.//: the magnification: the glass and the plus swell about the lens centre

reverse.//: zooming out: the lens shrinks instead of swelling (no more than 0.88, so it never parts from the handle), and the bar lies back down with the same landing
